profile.headline: Software Engineer at YardView
profile.summary:
Tech:  TypeScript, JQuery, Bootstrap,  C#,  Dotnet, GIT, JavaScript, Jenkins, MaterialUI, NPM, Object-oriented Programming, Postgres, React, RestAPI, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, SQL, Visual Basic, SwagUI/Postman.


Full Stack Developer, with a passion for problem solving and data. Currently specializing in Dotnet, C#, Javascript/TypeScript, VB and SQL Databases.
